name: speall-mri
sc:name: Speall MRI Brain Dataset
sc:description: A clinical brain MRI collection of 1,105 patient studies containing 355,133 DICOM files (~66 GB raw, 34,574 series) acquired between December 2021 and October 2024. The corpus spans four scanner vendors (GE, Philips, Siemens, Toshiba) and both 3.0T and 1.5T field strengths. Each series ships a detail JSON with 240+ DICOM metadata columns, volumetric statistics, automated quality grading (A-F), an ML training score (0-100), multiplane montages, intensity histograms, contrast-enhanced views, and a slice tar archive.

distribution.sc:name: manifest.parquet
distribution.sc:description: Series-level manifest: one row per series with metadata, quality grades, ML scores, and paths to derived artifacts.

distribution.sc:name: study_manifest.parquet
distribution.sc:description: Study-level manifest: one row per study with aggregate statistics, scanner information, and study-level quality summary.

distribution.sc:name: Slice tar shards
distribution.sc:description: Per-series slice archives. Each tar contains the raw DICOM slices for one series.

recordSet.sc:name: series
recordSet.sc:description: One record per MRI series. Contains DICOM metadata, quality grades, ML training scores, and paths to derived artifacts.

cr:field.sc:name: study_id
cr:field.sc:description: Anonymised study identifier.

cr:field.sc:name: series_uid
cr:field.sc:description: Unique series instance UID (de-identified).

cr:field.sc:name: series_number
cr:field.sc:description: DICOM series number within the study.

cr:field.sc:name: series_description
cr:field.sc:description: DICOM SeriesDescription tag (e.g. 'Ax DWI', '3D Ax SWAN').

cr:field.sc:name: sequence_type
cr:field.sc:description: Classified sequence type (e.g. DWI, FLAIR, T1, TOF).

cr:field.sc:name: vendor
cr:field.sc:description: Scanner manufacturer (GE, Philips, Siemens, Toshiba).

cr:field.sc:name: model
cr:field.sc:description: Scanner model name (e.g. SIGNA Pioneer, Achieva).

cr:field.sc:name: field_strength_T
cr:field.sc:description: Static magnetic field strength in Tesla (1.5 or 3.0).

cr:field.sc:name: file_count
cr:field.sc:description: Number of DICOM files in the series.

cr:field.sc:name: quality_grade
cr:field.sc:description: Automated quality grade (A–F) based on SNR, CNR, uniformity, coverage, and entropy.

cr:field.sc:name: quality_score
cr:field.sc:description: Numeric quality score (0–100) corresponding to the quality grade.

cr:field.sc:name: ml_score
cr:field.sc:description: Composite ML training suitability score (0–100) weighted by CNR, noise, bias, sharpness, histogram separation, and inter-slice consistency.

cr:field.sc:name: ml_grade
cr:field.sc:description: ML training grade (A–F) derived from ml_score.

cr:field.sc:name: commercial_tier
cr:field.sc:description: ML training tier label: premium, standard, usable, limited, or exclude.

cr:field.sc:name: detail_path
cr:field.sc:description: Relative path to the per-series detail JSON file.

cr:field.sc:name: montage_path
cr:field.sc:description: Relative path to the multiplane montage PNG (axial, coronal, sagittal).

recordSet.sc:name: studies
recordSet.sc:description: One record per patient study. Contains study-level aggregates, scanner information, and study acquisition metadata.

cr:field.sc:name: study_id
cr:field.sc:description: Anonymised study identifier.

cr:field.sc:name: study_date
cr:field.sc:description: Date the study was acquired (de-identified; year and month preserved).

cr:field.sc:name: n_series
cr:field.sc:description: Number of series in the study.

cr:field.sc:name: n_files
cr:field.sc:description: Total DICOM file count for the study.

cr:field.sc:name: vendor
cr:field.sc:description: Primary scanner manufacturer for the study.

cr:field.sc:name: model
cr:field.sc:description: Primary scanner model for the study.

cr:field.sc:name: field_strength_T
cr:field.sc:description: Static magnetic field strength in Tesla.

cr:field.sc:name: study_description
cr:field.sc:description: DICOM StudyDescription tag (e.g. 'BRAIN P+C', 'BRAIN ANGIO').
